card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a longer number, such as the 1 in 1860, the 0 in 77,000, or the 2 in 6:24-26. It fires in dates, ranges, counts, areas and section references.

modes.label: Digit within a range or area
modes.description: A digit that starts or sits inside a number in a range or a unit conversion.

modes.label: Digit within a year or count
modes.description: A digit partway through a year or a comma-separated large count.
modes.example: Before his election in <<1>>860, Lincoln was perhaps best

modes.label: Digit in a dose or section number
modes.description: A digit inside a dosing duration or a cross-reference number.

card.writes: It promotes spaces and ellipsis marks, so it adds little clear output effect beyond non-digit continuations.
card.plain: It lights up on a digit in the middle of a longer number, like the 0 in 77,000 or the 1 in 1860.
